nodes.label: Next.js Bleeding-Edge Caveat Rule
nodes.rationale: This repo runs a Next.js version with breaking changes vs training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: On-Prem Outbound-Only Architecture
nodes.rationale: Sensitive worker data (mail, conversations, agent memory) never leaves the PC; the worker PC only makes outbound HTTPS to the control plane, so no inbound ports, no VPN, no exposed credentials. The control plane only orchestrates pairing, remote commands, software distribution and aggregated telemetry.

nodes.label: Stack Distribution as Package Manager
nodes.rationale: AI-Office Center acts as package manager of its own stack: publish bundles, pin versions per firm, client bootstraps and verifies sha256, auto-update via heartbeat version diff when stackAutoUpdate=true.

nodes.label: clawhub v0 Domain Model (Firm, User, Instance, Heartbeat, PairingToken)
nodes.norm_label: clawhub v0 domain model (firm, user, instance, heartbeat, pairingtoken)

nodes.label: Instance States (unpaired/online/offline)
nodes.rationale: Status is computed in query from last_heartbeat_at with a 3-minute threshold, not stored; v0 accepts polling lag instead of real time.

nodes.label: Column-Based Multi-Tenant Strategy (firm_id)
nodes.rationale: Column-based tenancy (firm_id on each relevant table) chosen as sufficient for v0; multi-tenant data leakage mitigated with isolation-specific tests and auth middleware checking firm_id on every query.

nodes.label: clawhub Tech Stack Decisions
nodes.rationale: Prisma over Drizzle for maturity and declarative schema; Supabase for free tier plus realtime tooling for v0.5+; Vercel for 1-click deploy aligned with Next.js; jsonb extras for forward compatibility.

nodes.label: clawhub-agent Headless Phone-Home Client
nodes.rationale: Single-file Node 18+ client with no Electron and no npm install, for PCs that already run a gateway+bridge and want to appear in clawhub without installing the full clawgents-desktop.

nodes.label: Unified Flow: configurator → clawhub → installer → machine
nodes.rationale: Decision (17-jun): reactivate and close small gaps instead of rebuilding clawhub, because clawhub already models the whole flow (license=Firm, install code=PairingToken, machine=Instance, package=FirmBaseline, installer=StackBundle, kill-switch=InstanceCommand+Firm.status, billing=UsageRecord).
nodes.norm_label: unified flow: configurator → clawhub → installer → machine

nodes.label: clawhub as License Authority
nodes.rationale: Registration validates against Firm (exists + active) in clawhub, NOT against smartbotics; smartbotics is retired from the installer or reduced to only creating the Firm at sale time. The installer's validate_license points to clawhub.

nodes.label: Kill-Switch: Suspend/Resume Instances by Subscription
nodes.rationale: The cut is a real suspended mode (gate on tasks/chat), reversible, does not kill processes (JJ decision); heartbeat keeps HTTP 200 while suspended so monitoring of the instance continues; reuses all existing pairing, heartbeat, command auth and admin endpoints.

nodes.label: Bridge Suspension Gate (402 subscription_suspended)
nodes.rationale: Suspension flag persists in a file (<BRIDGE_DATA_DIR>/.suspended) to survive restarts; POST /api/tasks and /api/chat/send return 402 before dispatching when suspended.

nodes.label: Client Dispatcher Translates firm_status to Bridge suspend/resume
nodes.norm_label: client dispatcher translates firm_status to bridge suspend/resume

nodes.label: Block First-Pair for Firms Without Promoted Baseline
nodes.rationale: A firm without a promoted FirmBaseline can emit pairing codes but the installer always fails at provisioning, discovered days later on the client machine (real case 11-jul). Decision (JJ): disable first-pair with banner; re-pair only shows a warning. Server actions re-check the rule because disabled buttons are not a security barrier (server actions are independent POST endpoints). No changes to v0/* APIs, no migrations; clawhub cannot auto-create baselines because only the configurator wizard fabricates the package.
nodes.norm_label: block first-pair for firms without promoted baseline

nodes.label: CI/CD Bundle Auto-Publish Flow (tag v* → Release → register)
nodes.rationale: Workflows are copied into the producing repos (autonomous-agents, overlays, openclaw fork, clawgents-desktop); pushing a v* tag packs the artifact, creates a GitHub Release and auto-registers the bundle in clawhub so the operator only has to pin it to firms.
nodes.norm_label: ci/cd bundle auto-publish flow (tag v* → release → register)

nodes.label: release-installer.yml Workflow (kind=INSTALLER, .exe)
nodes.rationale: Runs on windows-latest because electron-builder NSIS only works on Windows; code-signing (CSC_LINK) left commented until an OV certificate is available.
